dataList.title: Selva Oscura
dataList.desc:
Aku berdiri di tengah hutan gelap,
alasan dan masa laluku telah lenyap dariku.
Yang kumiliki hanyalah sebuah jam yang menggantikan kepalaku,
dan juga sebuah bis yang muncul dari hutan.

dataList.title: The Outcast
dataList.desc:
Aku diberi peran sebagai Manajer.
Pemandu saya menginstruksikan diriku untuk menemukan cabang emas, yang mana kusetujui.
Tanpa disadari,
aku berjalan masuk ke salah satu mimpi buruk.

dataList.title: The Unloving
dataList.desc:
Para penyusup mengambil Golden Bough-nya.
Penuh kekecewaan, Sang Pemandu memberi kesempatan lain.
Bertekad untuk berhasil kali ini,
kami berbaris memasuki dunia
penuh kesenangan dan es.

dataList.title: The Unconfronting
dataList.desc:
Curtains close on a blithe yet chilling comedy.
Afterward, I could vaguely sense
that a tragedy lies in wait.
The bus rumbled along.
In the window, I saw fall a silent night.

dataList.title: The Unchanging
dataList.desc:
We received our first request.
The excitement was short-lived as we watched chaos unfold in the middle of K Corp's Nest.
Time is winded as usual, and a pair of downcast eyes catch my attention.

dataList.title: The Evil Defining
dataList.desc:
Amidst the conflict that knew no end,
We set sail on the Great Lake.
Into its ineffable Waves,
Into the flames of a certain wrath.

dataList.title: The Heartbreaking
dataList.desc:
The colors are fading,
and a storm is approaching.
Beyond the glass windows,
we see the wuthering heights.

dataList.title: The Tale of a Great Fixer Who Once Reached for The Dream
The Dream Ending
dataList.desc:
With our hearts leaden,
we disembark the train.
In me is a certain truth hidden,
forgotten even by whom it concerns.

dataList.title: The Surrendered Witnessing
dataList.desc:
His watching Jade eye 
sees beyond where our visions lie.
Not yet knowing where the eye gazes,
I walk still, into where buildings make mazes.

dataList.title: Second Round of the Family Hierarch Evaluation
The Unsevering
dataList.desc:
Instead of the bus that never returned
came the news of an attack upon the unassailable.
Caught within the chaos,
I quietly behold what is wreathed there:
A spider's web, woven of red thread.
